c3minigamebridge.name: MiniGameBridge
c3minigamebridge.description: Bridge to WeChat, Douyin and TikTok host capabilities through the companion adapter.

platform.name: Platform
platform.desc: Auto-detect the host, or require a specific platform.

score-endpoint.name: Score endpoint
score-endpoint.desc: Your HTTPS score submission endpoint. Leave blank to disable score reporting. No platform app secret belongs here.

on-ready.description: The companion bridge initialized in a supported mini game host.

on-login-succeeded.description: The platform returned a one-time login code, or a configured server returned a session. This is not a verified server identity by itself.

on-ad-completed.description: The host explicitly confirmed a complete rewarded video. Only this condition should grant a reward.

on-ad-cancelled.description: The rewarded video closed without completing; do not grant a reward.

on-score-reported.description: The configured score endpoint accepted the request.

on-vibration-completed.description: The host accepted the vibration request.

on-error.description: An operation failed. Inspect LastError, LastErrorCode and LastOperation; generic API operations also provide LastAPIName and LastAPITag.

on-api-succeeded.description: An API call, synchronous read or subscription action succeeded. Read LastAPIName, LastResultJSON and LastResultIsJSON.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Case-sensitive event tag. Use a distinct tag to distinguish concurrent operations or subscriptions.

on-api-event.description: A subscribed native event arrived. Read LastAPIName, LastEventJSON and LastEventIsJSON.

supports-api.description: Check whether this registered API is available in the current host. This does not grant permissions or invoke the API.

api-name.name: API name
api-name.desc: The exact registered platform API name. Case-sensitive.

init.description: Initialize using the Platform and Score endpoint properties. Wait for On ready.

login.description: Obtain a one-time platform login code. No code is sent automatically by this plugin.

show-rewarded-video.description: Display a platform rewarded video ad. Requires a real ad unit ID.

ad-unit-id.name: Ad unit ID
ad-unit-id.desc: The rewarded video ad unit ID issued by the selected platform.

report-score.description: Send a score to the configured HTTPS score endpoint.

vibrate.description: Request a short or long platform vibration.

call-api.description: Invoke a registered callback API. JSON options must be an object. Success and failure carry the supplied tag.

platform.description: Detected platform: douyin, wechat, tiktok, or unsupported.

last-operation.description: The operation associated with the latest result or error.

last-login-code.description: The most recent one-time platform login code, held only in memory. It is not proof of authenticated server identity.

last-api-name.description: API or event name associated with the current trigger, otherwise the latest API result.

last-api-tag.description: Tag associated with the current trigger, otherwise the latest API result.

last-result-json.description: Lossless JSON for the latest API result, or an empty string when it is not JSON data. Check LastResultIsJSON.

last-result-is-json.description: 1 when LastResultJSON contains valid lossless JSON; 0 for undefined, native objects, bytes or other non-JSON results.

last-result-type.description: Result type: null, array, or JavaScript typeof. Objects may be non-JSON; use LastResultIsJSON.

last-event-json.description: Lossless JSON for the current/latest event data, or empty when it is not JSON data.

last-event-is-json.description: 1 when LastEventJSON contains valid lossless JSON; otherwise 0.

last-event-type.description: Event data type: null, array, or JavaScript typeof.

capabilities-json.description: JSON capability descriptors with name, kind and supported status. Empty string when the bridge is unavailable. Does not call platform APIs.
